title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the Ampere force from force balance (mg = F tanθ) to obtain 0.8 N.

title: Magnetic field strength
description: Essential: Correctly computes magnetic induction B using F = BIL with proper length L = 2Rcosθ, yielding 0.4 T.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies equilibrium conditions to relate Ampere force, gravity, and normal forces with correct trigonometry.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem correctly to find speed at lowest point from mgR(1-sinθ) = ½mv².

title: Normal force calculation
description: Essential: Applies Newton's second law at lowest point (2F_N - mg = mv²/R) to find 0.54 N per ring.

title: Circuit current determination
description: Important: Correctly uses Ohm's law I = E/r with given values to find current of 2 A.

title: Effective length error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect length in F = BIL (e.g., uses R instead of 2Rcosθ or 1 m separation).

title: Trigonometric confusion
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies angle relationships in force balance (e.g., uses sin instead of tan).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations without conversion errors.
